x: 1.C.Lawton 6.11.45 (Course Record); 2.J.Eddershaw 6.13.05; 3.E.Shillabeer (Dawlish & S.Devon) 6.36.19. John Hall placed 4th in Sussex 10 km. on 3rd May in 47m 13s.

Incidentally three other walkers competed with distinction; Ed Shillabeer was 3rd, Arthur Eddlestone 4th and Stephen Till 6th. Congratulations also to John Keown on completing 25 consecutive ' Brightons ' 1300 Miles !!!!

A pleasant evening start and a cool night followed with Ed Shillabeer taking a 20 minute lead by 30 miles and Carl 2nd. As the night wore on John Morris who was going to retire at 40 miles kept going.

Charlie Weston (Highgate), Ed Shillabeer (Dawlish) and Bob Dobson (Southend) were the early leaders. As the hours progressed Ed Shillabeer went into a lead to win and retire at 100kms with a new British record.
